items.text: LA Chargers (early week, 0-8): QB Justin Herbert hurt his left (non-throwing) middle finger in Wk9, X-rays negative, Harbaugh says he 'should be good to go'. Day-to-day - WR Ladd McConkey (back spasms, did not play Wk9). Wk9 injuries - CB Isas Waxter, CB Cam Hart, DL Justin Eboigbe (all ankle). TE David Njoku and LB Denzel Perryman designated to return from IR.
items.source: ESPN (Harbaugh: X-rays on Herbert's finger negative, Nov 9)

items.text: Baltimore (Wednesday practice, MNF; first official report not yet released): All 50 roster players on the field. S Kyle Hamilton (hip) practicing; CB Nate Wiggins (illness) back; S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) returned to practice for the first time since Oct 21. Jacoby Brissett (acquired from ARI) took his first practice and starts vs LAC; QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) and QB Tyler Huntley on IR. OL Ryan Neuzil (from ATL) practicing. No kicker at practice after Jake Moody left; Ravens working out Harrison Mevis and Riley Patterson.
